## SIM-F19 — opportunity

Submerged-body volume displacement remains a distinct unresolved idea after ballistic spray.

**Rationale:** Old study found62–128 masked Water cells and predominantly lateral normals into Water; short chains covered <=1.6%. Ballistic launch does not automatically replace displaced body volume.

**Scope / validity:** Recorded four-family study with sweep-mask/precision corrections; no claim incidence is unchanged on current main. — historical_mechanism_evidence; present_runtime_extent_unverified
